description: This script scans for Storybook stories in the 'superset-core/src' directory, extracts metadata, generates MDX documentation pages for extension components, and creates type declaration files for the '@apache-superset/core/ui' package. It automates documentation and type generation for extension-compatible UI components in the Superset project.

methods.name: findStoryFiles
methods.description: Recursively searches for '.stories.tsx' files within the 'superset-core/src' directory.

methods.name: parseStoryFile
methods.description: Reads a story file and extracts metadata such as component name, description, import path, and story exports.

methods.name: extractArgsAndControls
methods.description: Parses story content to extract args, controls, and property descriptions for documentation.

methods.name: generateMDX
methods.description: Creates MDX documentation content for a component, including live examples, props table, and source links.

methods.name: generateIndexMDX
methods.description: Generates an index MDX page listing all extension components with usage instructions.

methods.name: extractComponentTypes
methods.description: Extracts type and component declarations from a component's index.tsx file.

methods.name: generateTypeDeclarations
methods.description: Creates a TypeScript declaration file for all extension components, referencing types and props.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function orchestrating the discovery, parsing, documentation, and type generation process.
